step1_figure.circuit_type: Common-Source Amplifier with Current Source Load
step1_figure.description: Common-source amplifier where xm1 acts as the amplifying input transistor, loaded by an active cascode PMOS current source (xm2, xm3) biased by the wide-swing cascode bias generator (SUB_1 from Figure 20.43 and Section 21.2.1).

slew_rate.description: Maximum charging rate of the output load capacitance limited by current source bias current

equation.explanation: When M1 turns off, the current load provides constant charging current I to the load capacitor C_L.
equation.assumptions: M1 is completely turned off and current source remains in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_bias = 20 uA and C_L = 100 fF (1e-13 F): SR = 20e-6 A / 1e-13 F = 200e6 V/s = 200 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard biasing provides ~10-30 uA across process corners into 100 fF load.

slew_time.description: Time required for the amplifier output to slew across the output voltage swing

equation.explanation: Calculates transition time for a given voltage change under slewing conditions.
equation.assumptions: Constant current charging across full swing Delta_V.

sky130_expected.calculation: For full swing Delta_V = 1.8 V with C_L = 0.1 pF and I = 20 uA: t_slew = 0.1e-12 * 1.8 / 20e-6 = 9.0 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct calculation based on VDD=1.8V and typical 20 uA bias.

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal voltage gain of the common-source amplifier

equation.explanation: Voltage gain is the total parallel resistance at the output node divided by resistance looking into the source of M1.
equation.assumptions: Both M1 and load transistors operate in saturation region.

sky130_expected.calculation: For PMOS M1 with W/L=10/1, Id=20uA, beta_p=50uA/V^2*10=500uA/V^2: gm1=sqrt(2*beta*Id)=sqrt(2*500e-6*20e-6)=141.4 uA/V. ro1=1/(lambda*Id)=1/(0.1*20u)=500k. With cascode PMOS load, ro_load >> ro1, Rout ~ ro1 = 500k. |Av| = 141.4 uS * 500k = 70.7 V/V -> 37.0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High impedance cascode load yields single-transistor limited gain ro1.

open_circuit_gain.description: Inherent maximum small-signal gain achievable by the common-source transistor

equation.explanation: Theoretical maximum intrinsic gain when active load output resistance is infinite.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated directly using device parameters lambda=0.1/V and W/L=10.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal resistance looking into the output node

equation.explanation: Effective resistance at the high-impedance output drain node to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: ro1 = 1 / (lambda * Id) = 1 / (0.1 * 20uA) = 500 kOhm. For cascode load, Rout ~= ro1 = 500 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by channel length modulation of M1 at 20 uA bias.

dominant_pole_frequency.description: Dominant pole frequency determined by output node resistance and capacitance

equation.explanation: Sets the 3-dB bandwidth of the high-impedance output node.
equation.assumptions: C_out dominated by load capacitor Cload = 100 fF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Rout ~ 500 kOhm with Cload = 100 fF yields ~3 MHz dominant pole.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where the amplifier voltage gain drops to unity (0 dB)

equation.explanation: Gain-bandwidth product of the single-stage amplifier.
equation.assumptions: Single dominant pole rolloff at -20 dB/decade until unity gain.

sky130_expected.reasoning: gm1 = 141.4 uS charging 100 fF gives GBW ~ 225 MHz.

rhp_zero_frequency.description: Right-half plane zero caused by gate-drain capacitive feedthrough

equation.explanation: Zero occurs where forward transconductance current equals feedthrough displacement current.
equation.assumptions: Small-signal model with overlap capacitance Cgd1.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Cgd1 ~ 2 fF for 10 um width: fz = 141.4e-6 / (2*pi * 2e-15) = 11.25 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High transconductance relative to small parasitic overlap capacitor puts zero in tens of GHz.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice testbench measuring DC transfer characteristic, small-signal voltage gain, 3dB bandwidth, unity-gain frequency, output resistance, and transient slew rate.
